title: Greater Defenceless - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Greater Defenceless in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: The Monolith - Tainted Hearts, merchant past the handholds, 47,600 Chroma

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Greater Defenceless is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Applies a stronger Defenceless.

sections.title: How to Get Greater Defenceless
sections.content: Location: The Monolith - Tainted Hearts, merchant past the handholds, 47,600 Chroma.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
